text:
Escalating to human 2026-05-12 during /do-beads sweep. Bead is unambiguously feature-typed with closed deps and was filed in pkix-profiles-cabf with the right disclaimer language, but two open questions need confirmation before autonomous claim:

**Question 1 — scope vs three-mode model.** Bead was last updated 2026-05-11. The three-mode policy architecture (AGENTS.md non-negotiable #5) was ratified 2026-05-12 and explicitly bounds pkix-profiles-cabf to a 'small curated reference set' as the unprincipled exception, with 'NOT a template' language. The current pkix-profiles-cabf::SmimeProfile is one tier (Mailbox-validated, lines 248-284). PKIX-jbvb expands to all 4 BR S/MIME mailbox-binding tiers — 4x growth. Two readings:
- (A) 'small subset of BR' = OK with 4 tiers, since they share BR §6.1.5/§6.3.2/§7.1.3/§7.3 substrate and only differ in DN/SAN/policy-OID predicates.
- (B) 'small marquee reference' = the existing 1 tier (Mailbox-validated) already serves the marquee purpose; comprehensive CA/B Forum S/MIME coverage belongs to pkix-policy-zlint or pkix-policy-pkilint, not to pkix-profiles-cabf.

Mark's call. (My weak guess: option A since the bead was already aware of the framework-vs-policy distinction when it landed, and the 4 tiers are tightly related variations of one BR section. But I cannot tell without explicit confirmation whether 'NOT a template' applies horizontally only (no -mozilla, -fedramp, -dod) or also vertically inside pkix-profiles-cabf.)

**Question 2 — test-cert sourcing.** Acceptance criterion: 'Test certs are independently sourced or generated; do NOT rely on pkix-profiles-cabf's own profile types to produce the expected verdict.' Per AGENTS.md test integrity. For each of Organization-/Sponsor-/Individual-validated tiers I need one positive cert (matches tier) + one negative cert (rejected by tier). 'Independently sourced or generated' means:
- (a) real-world CA-issued S/MIME certs from a public CA whose tier assertion is documented (Sectigo/DigiCert publish per-tier CPSs);
- (b) hand-generated certs cross-verified against an external oracle (zlint cabf_smime/pkilint cabf_smime); or
- (c) test fixtures from upstream zlint testdata at ~/GIT/zlint/v3/lints/cabf_smime/*/testdata/, attributed under Apache-2.0.

Option (c) seems most aligned with how PKIX-hbzo.1.3 plans to source its zlint corpus. Confirm before I commit to fixture provenance.

**If both questions land in 'proceed':** ready to decompose into PKIX-jbvb.1 / .2 / .3 (Organization / Sponsor / Individual) per the bead's own 'Decomposition' section and claim the first child.

**If question 1 lands in 'do not expand pkix-profiles-cabf':** bead should be closed WONTFIX, with the comprehensive S/MIME BR coverage tracked under PKIX-jy95.1 (pkix-policy-zlint) or a sibling pkix-policy-pkilint epic.

Removing human label and proceeding requires Mark's explicit answer on both questions.
